home.subtitle: Convert, compress, and resize images right on your device. Nothing is uploaded, nothing is tracked, and it works offline.
home.feature.private.title: Private by design
home.feature.private.body: Files are processed locally and never leave your device.
home.feature.bulk.title: Built for bulk
home.feature.bulk.body: Drop hundreds of files or a whole folder, then download everything as one ZIP.
home.feature.fast.title: No installs, no limits
home.feature.fast.body: No accounts, file caps, or watermarks. Just open and go.

jwt.error.parts: A JWT has three parts separated by dots (header.payload.signature).

uuid.hint.v4: Fully random. The classic choice for IDs and tokens.
uuid.hint.v7: Starts with the creation time, so IDs sort in order. Better for database keys.
timestamp.invalid: Enter Unix seconds, milliseconds, or a date such as 2026-10-11T12:00:00Z.
json.error.end: The JSON ends too early. Something is not closed.
